title: Cover directions with six fixed actuators and disperse one nonresonant mode in critical Fourier norm
statement: The fixed family F0={(e_i,e_j):i!=j} contains six integer/rational coordinate actuators independent ofnu,K,B,targetaccuracy. For any k!=0 choose dominant |k_j|>=|k|/sqrt3 and any i!=j. Every allowedrho=1/1024 calibration satisfies |theta(e_j+e).k|> |k|/2, so the compiler can prescribe all six without knowing which is good for a given mode. For fixedp=e3, transversexi!=0 and alpha_speed=2pi*a_tilde.xi, exact Leray dynamics splits into free cosine and in-plane Jacobi with bonds[j(j+1)+|xi|^2]/[2sqrt(j^2+|xi|^2)sqrt((j+1)^2+|xi|^2)]; staticphase is gauged out. The exact coefficients/short-range scattering overlap the current Root fixed-sector operation, credited once. Prior per-fixedxi ell1->ellinfinity dispersion plus unitarity and an outgoing-ladder split gives F_-1(U_s w_k)<=C_xi_prime*[1+log(2+|alpha_speed|*s)]/(1+|alpha_speed|*s)^(1/6)*|w_hat(k)|. For a covered actuator |alpha_speed|>pi|k| uniformly in its calibration. This proves a genuine single-mode fixed-frequency mixing mechanism; C_xi_prime is only finite for each fixedsector, without a computable polynomial uniform bound or a full robust word/controller theorem. ROOT subsequently closes the uniform single-sector prefactor: F_-1(U_s w)<=C*(1+|xi|)^8*(1+log(2+tau))*(1+tau)^(-1/3)*|w_hat|,tau=2pi*s*|a_actual.xi|,uniform in initial ladder index/staticphase, by U1777-root-uniform-polynomial-Jacobi-dispersion-and-mode-critical-bound. A43D original finite-constant t^-1/6 estimate above remains its source scope. This strengthened one-sector operation is not a full calibrated-word/controller proof.
